name: website-rebuild
title_zh: 逐行反编译压缩包，1:1 复刻获奖创意网站
tagline_zh: 不是截图仿制，是镜像取证。逐行追踪压缩代码里的行号，把 WebGL 动效、滚动叙事原样移植，过量化验收门才算完。
tagline_en: Not pixel-peeping—mirror-first forensics. Trace minified bundles line by line, port WebGL & scroll narratives.
desc_en: 1:1 rebuild of award-winning creative websites (WebGL / scroll-animation / portfolio sites). Evidence-driven pipeline - mirror-first forensics, line-number-traceable reverse engineering of minified bundles, verbatim porting, quantitative verification gates. Use when user asks to "复刻网站", "重建网站", "1:1 rebuild", "clone this site", or provides a URL of a creative/award site to reproduce.
why_zh: 证据驱动而非肉眼对齐：先镜像抓包再逆向，行号可追溯，移植逐字逐句，验收靠数字门禁，杜绝‘差不多’式复刻。
why_en: Evidence over eyeballing: mirror-first, line-traceable reverse engineering, verbatim porting, and quantitative verification—no.
limit_zh: 只认静态创意站点（WebGL/滚动动画/作品集）；需目标 URL 可公开访问且无登录墙。不处理后端逻辑。
limit_en: Static creative sites only (WebGL/scroll/portfolio); URL must be public, no auth. No backend, API keys, or paid assets. Output is front-end code.
